about_the_game:
This is a demo version of the game, which contains the first 7 locations, most of the profession and a huge number of quests. We have disabled content that we believe is still not ready for the final version, and restricted access to locations that are not yet fully ready.

Interesting quests

Tired of boring assignments? Did you hire a dwarf to do the dialogue for you? You can fire him, because you won't want to miss our quests! Fascinating stories, original characters, pleasant humor and a high-quality non-stressful plot made with love will leave you enchanted! And non-linear quests will allow you to truly feel your contribution!

Combat system

Use tactics to defeat the enemy! Each opponent has their own unique set of strengths and weaknesses: choose weapons and techniques to inflict maximum damage! Oh, I think he wants to blow your face off! Choose the right moment to dodge and punish the scoundrel! Still not strong enough? Upgrade your skills and develop your abilities so that you don't give the enemy a chance! It's not you who are stuck on a continent with monsters – it's the monsters who are stuck with you!

Professions

Master one of four professions: farming, cooking, alchemy, and arsenalist. Wait, "alone"? How about mastering all of them and becoming a craft avatar! Open your own business and sell the fruits of your labors for exorbitant prices! The antimonopoly service won't do anything to you, because it wasn't invented in the Middle Ages!

Home ownership

Tired of wandering? Buy your own house and decorate it with quest rewards! Invite your friends to visit and harness them to farm on your personal plot!

Exploring the world

Explore a detailed world while traveling through picturesque locations! Solve riddles, conduct excavations, find hiding places and unlock new entries in the game diary! Become a real researcher!

Free trade

Why bargain with NPCs when you can offer goods to real players? Exchange items, sell loot, buy materials, and enjoy an economy where you decide how much your right boot will cost!

Social gameplay

Do you prefer to play in company? We have leisure time for all your friends! Go through dungeons and joint quests, help other players, join groups, chat and level up together! Have you found many friends? Create your own guild! Collect materials and complete special guild quests to get your own estate and climb the leaderboard! P.S. Friends are not included with the game, but you can always find them here! Just offer to complete a pair task!

A dynamic world

Watch the world change before your eyes! Bargain during the day, complete unique quests at night and avoid getting caught in sudden rain! We take care of our NPCs, so we let them go to sleep after sunset! However, some of them, on the contrary, prefer to stay awake only at night! As well as especially dangerous monsters prowling through the forest by moonlight...

PVP Content

Challenge any player and show what you can do! Arrange tournaments, and then celebrate the victory together in the tavern! A mug of strong after a beating is the key to a good mood.

Interacting with the world

What happens if I click on this cabinet? What if I steal an axe? Find out the answers by interacting with the interior and unlock secret quests!
